constraints.description: Every fact must reference source evidence; unsupported LLM claims are rejected, never stored as truth.
Never overwrite original source values with normalized values; retain both.
Use deterministic code for arithmetic, unit conversion, and comparison; LLMs handle semantics only.
Embeddings are for candidate discovery, never final truth determination.
Starter datasets stay outside the repo at ../starter-datasets; no dataset-specific production logic.
No Neo4j/Redis/Kafka/Celery/Kubernetes without a demonstrated need.

decisions.rationale: Simplest reviewer-friendly workflow for a take-home; chosen by maintainer over uv/Poetry.
decisions.title: Dependency management: pip + requirements.txt

decisions.rationale: Phase 0 is connectivity foundation only; domain schema arrives with Phase 1/Phase 4 when requirements are concrete.
decisions.title: Defer domain tables and migrations to Phase 1/4

decisions.rationale: Maintainer requested machine-readable JSON with stable node/relationship IDs at docs/PROJECT_KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH.json.
decisions.title: Knowledge graph representation: JSON

decisions.rationale: Standard FastAPI/Postgres stack; pgvector integrates cleanly; avoids extra infrastructure.
decisions.title: ORM: SQLAlchemy 2.0 + psycopg

decisions.rationale: Readiness probes must distinguish a live app from a down dependency; never 500 on DB outage.
decisions.title: /health always 200 with nested database status

deviations_from_plan.reason: Maintainer instruction: backend first, do not scaffold frontend yet.

implementation_state.vector_extension: pgvector image in Compose; extension not yet enabled (no schema)

invariants: Original source values are preserved alongside normalized values.
Context is checked before declaring contradiction.
Every relationship must be explainable and grounded in evidence.

nodes.responsibility: Application factory (create_app) and router wiring. No business logic.
GET /health. Returns app status plus nested database reachability.
pydantic-settings environment config: database URL, LLM/AWS placeholders, dataset dir.
SQLAlchemy 2.0 engine + SessionLocal + get_db + non-raising connectivity check.
Relational + vector storage via pgvector/pgvector:pg16 service (db). Persistent volume pgdata.
Reproducible local setup: db + backend services, env-based config.
Behavior tests: import/startup, /health 200 + shape incl. database distinction.
